status.evidence: According to UK Companies House and Convergence Partners records, Ctrack UK Limited is currently active and was acquired by Ctrack, backed by Convergence Partners, in December 2024.

claims.claim: The company reports in its asset tracking specifications that its GPS telematics units utilize roaming SIM cards supporting 2G, 3G, and 4G networks to optimize cellular coverage across geographic regions.

As reported by Fleet News in March 2026, the company rolled out its next-generation fleet and asset management platform, Crystal, in the UK, which integrates real-time telematics with predictive analytics and AI-driven modular configurations.

In July 2025, A1 Group adopted Ctrack UK Limited's AI-powered video telematics and Progressive Safe System (PSS) solution across 110 commercial vehicles, achieving a verified 40% reduction in driver distractions.

In March 2026, RDM Electrical & Mechanical Services deployed Ctrack UK Limited's plug-and-play telematics devices alongside its Executive Dashboard software to monitor driver behaviour, fuel efficiency, and fleet utilisation trends.

A1 Group announced the deployment of an AI-powered Progressive Safe System (PSS) across 110 commercial vehicles using Ctrack's dual-view AI dashcams, which provide integrated continuous forward-facing road recording and driver-facing risk assessment.

Ctrack UK offers a formal hardware specification for its CT5500-G model, a ruggedised 5-channel mobile digital video recorder (MDVR) designed for commercial vehicle surveillance that includes built-in GPS positioning, 1080p resolution, Wi-Fi data upload, and structural integration with left-turn alert alarms and proximity sensors.
claims.source: Ctrack UK Hardware Specifications (5-channel connected dvr spec sheet)

claims.claim: The company reports in its official Privacy Policy that it employs encryption via SSL certificates to secure traffic between users and its site, while hosting information on secured server infrastructure utilizing physical, technical, and organizational security measures.

The company reports offering secure telematics API connections to customize integrations between its vehicle tracking software and third-party systems like ERP, routing, and transport management, as demonstrated in an integration partnership with Eworks Manager to stream real-time fleet analytics.
claims.note: The streaming of 'real-time fleet analytics' is unconfirmed; the official announcement states the integration shares 'real-time tracking data' for a 'workforce management solution'.
claims.source: Field Technologies Online / GeoConnexion Press Release (May 2019)

claims.claim: The company rolled out its next-generation management platform, Crystal, in the United Kingdom in March 2026, featuring an adaptable plug-in architecture designed to let operations scale up functionality by embedding modular plug-ins for workflow automation and predictive analytics as reported by Business Motoring.

RDM Electrical & Mechanical Services deployed a customized Ctrack fleet telematics solution across 80 commercial vans to monitor driver behaviour, vehicle utilisation, and fuel efficiency metrics, as reported by Transport UK in March 2026.
claims.note: Monitoring specific metrics like 'driver behaviour' and 'vehicle utilisation' is unconfirmed; the source specifies tracking vehicle operations, unauthorized usage, job allocation, and fuel consumption.

claims.claim: Pilkington Automotive implemented a fleet and video telematics solution from Ctrack across its 35-strong commercial van fleet to manage driver accountability and enhance road safety across seven UK distribution locations, as documented by HGV UK in April 2025.
Public sector procurement records show Ctrack UK Limited was awarded a fleet telematics contract by The Guinness Partnership Limited published on February 3, 2026, with a total value of £913,000.
claims.corrected: Public sector procurement records show Ctrack UK Limited was awarded a fleet telematics contract by The Guinness Partnership Limited published on March 25, 2026, with a total value of £913,000.

claims.claim: Ctrack UK entered into a technology partnership with field service management software provider Fast Lean Smart (FLS) to deliver integrated, real-time dynamic scheduling solutions for mobile FM and engineering teams in the UK.

Ctrack UK established a strategic partnership with automotive incident management specialist Artura to develop an integrated telematics-enabled accident and repair solution combining Ctrack's dashcam technology with Artura's incident management system.

The company reports that its telematics tracking systems are deployed in over 1.2 million vehicles across more than 50 countries globally, with over 3,000 active customers using its systems daily within the UK and Ireland.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its telematics tracking systems are deployed in over 1.2 million vehicles across more than 60 countries globally, with over 3,000 active customers using its systems daily within the UK and Ireland.

claims.claim: The company reports providing 24/7 customer ticketing availability via a dedicated Customer Self-Service Portal integrated with its internal CRM system, alongside a local support team that explicitly uses no offshore call centres.
claims.note: The details regarding "24/7 customer ticketing availability" and the local team explicitly using "no offshore call centres" are unverified for Ctrack UK (the "no offshore call centres" claim is actively marketed by Ctrack Australia, but not confirmed in published sources for Ctrack UK Limited).
